title: A polynomial-time construction of strong thin trees
summary: We give a deterministic polynomial-time construction of strong thin trees. Given a finite k -edge-connected loopless multigraph on at least one vertex, the algorithm constructs a spanning tree meeting every cut in at most a $`C/k`$ fraction of its edges, for a universal constant C . The running time is polynomial in the binary input length, including when parallel-edge multiplicities are encoded in binary.
family_title: Deterministic construction of strong thin spanning trees

review.reason: Presents a polynomial-time construction of spanning trees that are thin across all cuts.
